per_prompt.prompt: Users are seeing duplicate email notifications for the same event sometimes. Find where notification dedup is supposed to happen and tell me why it might be failing.
There's a report that pagination sometimes skips a row when items are inserted between page loads. Find where page offsets are computed and identify the exact logic involved.
Nobody remembers where the rate limiter actually enforces its window reset. Find it and report the file, the function, and what calls it.
The export job doesn't seem to close its temp files the way engineers expect, and disk usage creeps up over time. Find where temp files are created and cleaned up.
Some users report that their session gets logged out randomly even with 'remember me' checked. Find where session expiry is decided in this repo.
Where is the retry backoff for the webhook delivery worker implemented? I need to understand the current algorithm before changing it.
What calls the function that validates uploaded file types? I want to trace all the entry points before touching anything.
Figure out where the currency conversion rate gets cached and how staleness is checked, we're seeing outdated rates in production.
There's a report that concurrent writes to the same record occasionally lose an update. Find where optimistic locking or versioning is handled, if at all.
Localize the code path that decides whether a coupon code can stack with an existing discount. Behavior seems inconsistent between checkout and cart preview.
Identify where the search index is refreshed after a bulk import, since new items aren't showing up in search results for several minutes.
Which module handles converting user-uploaded images to thumbnails? Quality looks degraded compared to what the spec describes.
Some users complain that undo doesn't restore attachments, only the text body. Find where undo/redo state is captured.
There's a report that the background sync worker sometimes double-processes a queue item after a crash. Find where idempotency for queue processing is (or isn't) enforced.
This repo has a RateLimiter class somewhere. Find every other file that imports or constructs it and report which ones.
Somewhere in the billing module there's a test that checks proration math on a mid-cycle plan change. Find that test and tell me which file it's in.
Find every place that reads the FEATURE_FLAGS config, I want a list before I add a new flag.
There's a CacheEntry struct used for the response cache. Find all the files that construct one directly.
What touches the OrderStatus enum across the codebase? I want to know the blast radius before adding a new status value.
Find every other file in the repo that uses the SessionStore class, or report none if there aren't any.
In `oxidepy/cache.py`, rename the `TTLCache` class to `TimedCache`. Only touch that one file.
In `src/ui/Button.tsx`, add a one-line comment directly above the component saying `// TODO: memoize`. Only touch that one file.
In `oxidepy/http_client.py`, add a module-level docstring line at the very top if one is not already present.
In `src/net/retry.ts`, rename the exported const `defaultRetryPolicy` to `DEFAULT_RETRY_POLICY`.
Open `config/settings.py` and add a new line setting `DEBUG = False` right after the imports.
In `README.md`, fix the typo 'recieve' to 'receive' in the second paragraph.
Bump the version string in `package.json` from 1.2.3 to 1.2.4.
In `src/utils/date.ts`, change the default timezone parameter from 'UTC' to 'America/New_York'.
Add a `.gitignore` entry for `*.tmp` files at the end of the existing `.gitignore`.
In `tests/test_auth.py`, delete the `test_legacy_token_format` test function, only that function.
Rename the variable `usr` to `user` on line 42 of `src/models/user.py`. Only touch that file.
In `Cargo.toml`, add `serde_json = "1"` as a dependency.
Find the line in `src/main.rs` that prints the banner and change the text to say 'v2'. Only touch that one file.
In `docs/CHANGELOG.md`, add a one-line entry under Unreleased noting the version bump.
